Also included Full board Accommodation in standard room (Suite upon request) Access to the wellness and fitness areas HEALTH DIAGNOSTIC Exclusive 3-day medical check up _ Available at Clinique La Prairie Switzerland & China _ From CHF 17'680 From CNY 91'000 BOOK THIS PROGRAM Insights on Health Diagnostic What does our comprehensive medical check-up in Switzerland include? Our Health Diagnostic Program is a comprehensive 3-day medical check-up designed by our leading longevity clinic in Switzerland. It includes advanced blood analyses, medical imaging, functional and organ-specific assessments, as well as in-depth consultations with experienced medical experts and specialists to provide a complete and preventive health evaluation, rooted in the science of longevity . Who is the ideal candidate for a preventive check-up? This preventive medical check-up is ideal for adults who wish to take a proactive approach to their health, optimize longevity, or detect potential risks early. It is particularly suited for those with a family history of medical conditions who seek a thorough evaluation at a renowned longevity clinic. Will I receive personalized recommendations after my medical check-up? Yes. Following your medical check-up, you will receive a detailed health report along with personalized medical and lifestyle recommendations. These are tailored to your results and longevity goals, helping you make informed decisions to support long-term health and well-being. Can I customize my health check-up based on my specific concerns? Yes. While our Health Diagnostic program follows a structured medical framework, it is fully tailored to each individual. A pre-stay call with a doctor is included in the package, giving you the opportunity to connect before arrival so that your longevity program can be adapted to your personal concerns, medical history, and risk factors, ensuring everything is ready and personalized from day one. What specialists will I meet during my medical check-up in Switzerland? Your health journey in Montreux, Switzerland is coordinated by a dedicated medical lead, with access to specialists such as cardiologists, pulmonologists, dermatologists, gastroenterologists, and other experts as required to ensure a comprehensive assessment. How often should I undergo a preventive check-up? The recommended frequency of a preventive check-up depends on your age, lifestyle, and overall health profile. Following your assessment, your medical team will provide personalized guidance on appropriate follow-up to support long-term health and longevity. Is our Health Diagnostic suitable for all ages? The Health Diagnostic is designed for adults seeking a comprehensive and preventive medical evaluation. The program is adapted to individual needs, making it suitable for a wide range of ages focused on prevention, early detection, and longevity optimization.
